files.description: The primary (b)(10) EHI export documentation. 11-page PDF containing: export instructions with screenshots for single-patient and bulk CCD export, a detailed C-CDA data element mapping table (pages 6-10) with XPATH paths and code system OIDs for ~25 clinical data sections, descriptions of PDF-format exports for demographics/insurance/billing/appointments/messages/documents, and a single-sentence mention of FHIR Bulk Data support.

Mandatory disclosures document listing costs and contractual limitations for certified capabilities: patient portal (MedFusion), secure messaging (DataMotion), patient health information capture. Not directly EHI export documentation, but provides context on product dependencies.
